subtitle.description: Short status under the heading, such as "Updated 14 min ago". A change rises in.

onRefresh.description: Runs after a pull past the threshold or a press of the refresh button. Update items before it resolves; resolve with a short result such as "3 new updates".

threshold.description: Pull distance in px, after resistance, that arms a refresh.

doneLabel.description: Result shown when onRefresh resolves without one.

refreshLabel.description: Accessible name of the refresh button.
